notes.meaning: The speaker promises never to stay silent or rest until Jerusalem is fully restored. God will ensure that her right standing and rescue shine out clearly like a blazing torch in the dark. We can be confident that God will finish the good work He begins in His people.

Rulers and nations across the earth will see the glory and vindication God gives to His people. The Lord will also give Jerusalem a brand-new name to show how completely her life and standing have changed. True dignity comes from what God makes of us, not from worldly power.

The Lord will hold His people like a royal crown or headdress in the palm of His hand. Rather than wearing the crown, He holds it out to show the world how precious they are to Him. In His strong hand, they are safe from every enemy.

The city will no longer be called Abandoned or Desolate, as it was during the exile. Instead, God calls her by names meaning 'My Delight Is in Her' and 'Married.' These new names show that God loves His people deeply and has joined Himself to them in a lasting covenant.

God will celebrate over His people with the same joy that a groom feels on his wedding day. The children of the city will also be firmly united to the land, living in safety and peace. God does not just care for His people out of duty; He takes great pleasure in them.

The Lord has placed spiritual watchmen on the city walls who will never stop calling out day or night. These sentinels are told to keep reminding the Lord of His promises without taking any rest. It reminds us to stay watchful and persistent in our own prayer life.

The watchmen must keep praying until God firmly establishes Jerusalem and makes her admired across the earth. God invites His people to keep asking boldly until His good promises come to pass. He is never bothered by our continuous prayers for His help.

The Lord makes a solemn oath by His own right hand and almighty strength. He guarantees that invading enemies will never again seize the grain and wine that His people worked hard to produce. God's mighty power stands behind every promise He makes.

The workers who harvest the grain and pick the grapes will finally enjoy the fruit of their own labor. They will bring these gifts to the temple courts to celebrate feasts of thanksgiving before God. True blessing includes both having enough to eat and thanking the Lord who provided it.

The people are told to go out through the gates and build a wide, smooth highway for travelers. They must clear away the stumbling stones and raise a banner so the nations can see which way to go. God calls His people to remove obstacles so others can easily come to Him.

The Lord sends a message to the farthest corners of the earth, telling Jerusalem that her Savior is coming. He arrives with power, bringing peace, comfort, and rewards for His people. We can look forward with joy because our Deliverer brings everything we need.

God's people will receive new titles of honor, being named the Holy People and the Redeemed of the Lord. The city itself will no longer be considered forgotten, but will be known as a place sought out and treasured by God. God's rescue gives His people an entirely new identity and future.
